does: Reads graphicSettings.lsx from the profile (path root 4) into the graphic settings and writes them back; called by BaseApp::Start through App's vtable +0xA8 after the engine's API is up. Script Extender hooks it as App__LoadGraphicSettings and adds its game-state listeners in the post-hook.

evidence.says: live, copy attacks: slot +0xA8 of App's dx11 vtable (+0x5499F58) holds code:App::LoadGraphicSettings, which is Script Extender's App__LoadGraphicSettings (Ext.Debug.GetSymbolAddress); the Toolkit's App vtable has App::LoadAndResaveGraphicsSettings at +0xA8 and App::InitApp / App::InitGame at +0x98 / +0xB0, as the dx11 one
Script Extender's pattern: the function's prologue loads path root 4 and the text graphicSettings.lsx
The macOS build's symbols hold this name; nothing but the name ties it to this function
EoC.dll exports this name; nothing but the name ties it to this function

Timeline Step row (Script Extender's post-hook, two starts): ends 5890.1 / 5009.5 ms, 1.4 / 1.1 s after SDL_CreateWindow; graphicSettings.lsx itself is opened at 4420 ms, by BaseApp::Start's earlier config step (vtable +0x180), so this function's own read is not the file's first
